recipes.title: High protein butter chicken
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and garam masala
Heat oil in a pan medium-high heat
Sear chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown
Take the chicken out and saute the tomatoes and onions until soft
Blend them along with fresh cream
Dice the chicken, and add to the sauce and enjoy

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil and herbs for 30 minutes
Grill chicken for 6 to 8 minutes per side
Serve with fresh tomatoes and basil garnish
